As a researcher specializing in large language model (LLM), I would like to have a comprehensive literature review of recent data synthesis methods for tool-augmented (e.g., web search) LLM agent training, including but not limited to TaskCraft (Shi et al., 2025), Beyond Ten Turns (Gao et al., 2025), DeepDive (Lu et al., 2025), WebThinker (Li et al., 2025), WebShaper (Tao et al., 2025), WebWalkerQA (Wu et al., 2025), Search-R1 (Li et al., 2025), and AutoCoA (Zhang et al., 2025). 
For each algorithm, provide:
- Motivation and the core idea/innovation. 
- Key takeaways and claimed contributions. 
- Empirical setup: baselines, model(s) used, training configs, compute budget, and evaluation benchmarks/datasets with results (include metrics and headline numbers where available).
- Limitations and reported failure modes. 
- Only focus on works published (including Arxiv preprints) in 2025.
